human_language_and_why.detail: Label «Реестр результата (необязательно)» is plain Russian and marks the field optional. Helper hint explains the PURPOSE (ЗАЧЕМ): «Куда попадает результат шага процесса. По умолчанию — реестр приложения по умолчанию.» — a human sentence, no slugs/jargon. The empty first option «— по умолчанию —» communicates the default path.

error_display_russian_at_field.detail: REGISTRY_NOT_FOUND is mapped by mapBindingError to { field: 'target_registry_slug', message: serverMsg || 'Реестр не найден в этом приложении.' } and rendered as <span className='chs-hint chs-hint--invalid'> directly under the picker, replacing the helper hint. aria-invalid is set on the select. The error is anchored on the right field, in Russian, not a raw code.

design_tokens.detail: Uses the same primitives as the sibling fields in this modal: chs-field / chs-label / chs-input / chs-input--invalid / chs-hint / chs-hint--invalid, and var(--chs-color-text-muted) for the muted hint. No raw hex, no bespoke styling. Consistent with the trigger-type and application selects immediately adjacent.

empty_or_single_registry_state.detail: The picker renders only when `applicationId && regOpts.length > 0`. An app with no listable registries hides the picker entirely and the binding uses the default slug — correct minimalism (nothing to choose). An app with a single (default) registry shows it as a pickable option alongside «— по умолчанию —»; slightly redundant but harmless (see review NB-4). No broken/empty-select state is ever shown.

data_not_hardcode.detail: Options come from GET /api/registry-defs?application_id= (this tenant's real registries), fetched with authHeaders() (mode-aware — the FE-s46 bare-fetch-401 lesson is explicitly applied and commented). registryTargetOptions maps rows to { value: slug, label }, defensive against non-arrays / slug-less rows, never fabricates. Picker clears its value when the application changes (its registries differ).

non_blocking.text: On re-bind of an existing (process, app) pair the modal opens blank and does not pre-fill the current target_registry_slug; leaving the picker at default silently clears a previously-set slug on save (server upsert overwrites). No UI warning. Follow-up: pre-fill from the existing binding or warn on clear. (Mirrors review NB-2.)
